crime_description: Fixing the outcome of the heavyweight boxing championship. Interrogators should probe for connections to an inside accomplice, financial motives, and offshore accounts.

suspect.name: Nolan Nakamura
suspect.fake_alibi: Nolan claims he was placing bets at a casino in Vegas, nowhere near the fight.

secrets.value: The referee, who was bribed to ignore obvious fouls and call the fight early.
Nolan stood to win $10 million from illegal underground betting rings.
untraceable offshore account holding the illicit funds
